soundAtlas.title: Soundscape at a Listening Point
soundAtlas.disclaimer: Relative sound-source activity estimated from space-time data — not measured noise (not dB)
soundAtlas.scene.label: Real scene
soundAtlas.scene.taipei1109: Taipei 9 Nov: rain + Songshan flights + garbage trucks
soundAtlas.scene.heping1108: Heping, Taichung 8 Nov: Taipower lightning + flights
soundAtlas.scene.snapshotLoaded: Using the scene snapshot; sources missing from it use live data
soundAtlas.scene.snapshotMissing: No scene snapshot yet; all sources use live data
soundAtlas.scene.outside: Listening point is outside the scene area or on another date; using live data
soundAtlas.receiver.none: No listening point yet: press “Place listening point” and click the map, or choose a real scene.
soundAtlas.receiver.assumption: Outdoors, {h} m above ground (assumed); drag to move
soundAtlas.current.title: Main sources right now
soundAtlas.current.empty: No active sources near the listening point right now
soundAtlas.current.farAviation: Plus {count} distant aircraft (each below {min} relative potential, max {max}); the 24-hour chart still plots them
soundAtlas.current.unknownAviation: {count} more aircraft have track gaps; their position now is unknown (not silence)
soundAtlas.health.title: Source health
soundAtlas.health.thunderUnknown: Neither lightning source has data: cannot tell whether there was thunder — this does not mean quiet
soundAtlas.profile.title: 24-hour profile (10-minute bins)
soundAtlas.profile.gapNote: Hatched = cannot tell or no data (not 0); the right-hand % is its share; vertical axis is relative potential 0–1
soundAtlas.profile.none: Shown after placing a listening point
soundAtlas.reason.railStructure: Structure between stations unknown (no OSM match or portal)
soundAtlas.reason.roadNotCovered: Only freeway sections loaded; other roads have no data
soundAtlas.reason.roadworkNotCovered: Not covered: this city does not publish roadwork events
soundAtlas.reason.workHours: Within permit period, daily hours unknown
soundAtlas.row.roadProxyNote: Estimate, not traffic volume: road type only
soundAtlas.reason.typicalWeekend: Weekend or public holiday: no reliable typical value
soundAtlas.reason.typicalAnomaly: Anomalous day (e.g. typhoon): no same-day observation, typical value not applicable
soundAtlas.reason.typicalCalendar: Holiday calendar does not cover this date; cannot tell if it is a weekday
soundAtlas.reason.typicalMissing: No valid typical volume for this hour
soundAtlas.reason.typicalSample: Too few sample days for this hour
soundAtlas.row.typicalNote: Estimate: Dec 2025–Jan 2026 weekday typical value ({days}-day sample), not a same-day observation
